scenarios.title: Replay before watermark
scenarios.precondition: row NORMAL rev=4, E1, id=A committed, last_ts=T2
scenarios.input: same canonical A at T1; current last_ts=T2
scenarios.expected: EXACT_REPLAY; ledger=1; rev=4; no outbox; no new ACK
scenarios.evidence_required: ledger key/hash, control rev, classification trace

scenarios.title: Conflicting replay after restart
scenarios.precondition: snapshot restored with A hash H, rev=5
scenarios.input: A with changed signal/canonical H2
scenarios.expected: CONFLICTING_REPLAY; ledger=1; rev=5; no outbox
scenarios.evidence_required: durable hash, restart boot ID, incident/outbox

scenarios.title: Canonical/version mismatch
scenarios.precondition: A stored with canonical v1 and original-byte digest
scenarios.input: same semantic JSON with changed timestamp format, then v2 canonicalization request
scenarios.expected: conflict or explicit migration mapping; never silently reapply; rev fixed
scenarios.evidence_required: canonical spec/version and hashes

scenarios.title: Crash before commit
scenarios.precondition: fresh B after 2 bad; ledger and control tx open
scenarios.input: crash after ledger INSERT before COMMIT
scenarios.expected: rollback ledger/control/outbox; retry B commits once; exactly one OPEN
scenarios.evidence_required: WAL/tx log, row counts, commit boundary

scenarios.title: Commit then lost ACK
scenarios.precondition: B completes OPEN transaction
scenarios.input: terminate response path immediately after COMMIT
scenarios.expected: retry B exact replay, no second OPEN/outbox; ambiguous first ACK reconciled
scenarios.evidence_required: commit LSN/revision, ACK trace, outbox key

scenarios.title: Concurrent same identity
scenarios.precondition: two workers W1 W2, scope rev=7, E1
scenarios.input: both submit identical C
scenarios.fault_point: interleave unique insert and row lock
scenarios.expected: one committed application; other EXACT_REPLAY in fresh tx; one outbox max
scenarios.evidence_required: txn IDs, unique error, control rev, row count

scenarios.title: Concurrent conflicts/fence
scenarios.precondition: epoch E2 current, W1 stale E1, W2 valid E2
scenarios.input: W1 bad C, W2 good D
scenarios.fault_point: lease expiry between validation and write
scenarios.expected: W1 rejected at transactional epoch CAS, W2 only effective
scenarios.evidence_required: epoch revision, lock order, commits

scenarios.title: ENOSPC/SQLITE_BUSY
scenarios.precondition: ledger 90% capacity, durable OPEN and pending outbox
scenarios.input: new unique D and simulated disk full/busy
scenarios.fault_point: during journal/WAL write or lock acquisition
scenarios.expected: fail closed, no partial row/state/outbox, independent degraded signal
scenarios.evidence_required: disk fault log, integrity, alert receipt

scenarios.title: Tampered backup
scenarios.precondition: signed manifest over DB+ledger+outbox, gen=10
scenarios.input: modify ledger bytes/delete interruption row
scenarios.expected: quarantine; no intake or dispatch; no fallback to audit
scenarios.evidence_required: digest validation, restore decision

scenarios.title: Old valid signed backup
scenarios.precondition: witness gen=12, backup gen=10
scenarios.input: restore authentic gen=10
scenarios.expected: quarantine; no old sample reuse or lost pending notification
scenarios.evidence_required: manifest signatures, witness gen, intake gate

scenarios.title: Saturation/no eviction
scenarios.precondition: dedupe ledger at configured safe threshold
scenarios.input: 256 unique interruptions plus repeated old IDs
scenarios.expected: new IDs rejected/degraded, old IDs still EXACT_REPLAY; no state reset
scenarios.evidence_required: ledger counts, archived lookup, degraded receipt

scenarios.title: Storage recovery/archive
scenarios.precondition: ledger full, E1 active, OPEN incident and pending outbox
scenarios.input: increase capacity or archive immutable E1 after approved barrier
scenarios.expected: old IDs searchable, OPEN seq/pending outbox retained, intake only after verification
scenarios.evidence_required: retention manifest, replay lookup, row counts

scenarios.title: Unauthorized reset
scenarios.precondition: authenticated reader lacks recovery role
scenarios.input: request epoch reset/ledger truncate
scenarios.expected: DENY; ledger/control/outbox/witness unchanged
scenarios.evidence_required: audit of rejected operation, permissions

scenarios.title: Independent degraded status
scenarios.precondition: primary DB unavailable, external status channel healthy
scenarios.input: heartbeat and ENOSPC signal
scenarios.expected: UNKNOWN/NO_GO transmitted via separate fault domain; no false RECOVERED
scenarios.evidence_required: external receipt, topology proof, alert budget

scenarios.title: Outbox crash/retry
scenarios.precondition: OPEN transition committed, outbox id O=PENDING
scenarios.input: worker crash after send before delivery ACK
scenarios.expected: same idempotency key reused; receiver dedupes or status UNCERTAIN requiring reconcile
scenarios.evidence_required: receiver call log, outbox attempts, ack

scenarios.title: Legacy v1 migration
scenarios.precondition: v1 snapshot contains TRUSTED_INTERRUPTION audit no canonical ledger
scenarios.input: attempt live import
scenarios.expected: REJECT/QUARANTINE; never synthesize replay ledger from audit
scenarios.evidence_required: migration dry-run log, old snapshot digest

scenarios.title: Downgrade code/rollback
scenarios.precondition: new DB schema/gen and pending outbox
scenarios.input: start old code against new DB/restore older DB
scenarios.expected: old code blocked or read-only; no reset ledger/outbox
scenarios.evidence_required: schema version, deployment gate, checkpoint

scenarios.title: Spoofed identity
scenarios.precondition: server-bound resource rule producer P; unsigned event
scenarios.input: JSON source/rule spoof plus valid-looking id
scenarios.expected: REJECT before identity reservation; no state/ledger change
scenarios.evidence_required: auth decision, ledger no-row assertion

scenarios.title: WAL/replica gap
scenarios.precondition: ACKed gen=30; replica/archive at gen=29
scenarios.input: promote lagging replica or restore missing WAL
scenarios.expected: QUARANTINE until witness/committed log reconciled; no misleading ACK history
scenarios.evidence_required: LSN/timeline, witness, promotion logs

scenarios.title: Cooldown incident identity
scenarios.precondition: OPEN seq=8 alert at T0, bad streak as defined
scenarios.input: bad×3 at +899,+900,+901; recovery good×3
scenarios.expected: +899 suppressed; +900 eligible; +901 not additional unless newly qualified and cooldown; OPEN seq stable, RECOVERED same incident
scenarios.evidence_required: revision sequence, outbox keys, timestamps

scenarios.title: Cross-epoch replay laundering
scenarios.precondition: E1 U committed; epoch rotation authorized E2 with fence
scenarios.input: delayed U(E1) rewrapped as E2 or missing epoch
scenarios.expected: REJECT; no row in E2, no streak reset, archived E1 identity accessible
scenarios.evidence_required: signed envelope, epoch issuance, sequence barrier

scenarios.title: ACK to witness gap
scenarios.precondition: gen=40 anchored, event U would commit gen=41
scenarios.input: DB commit U then witness timeout before ACK; restore gen=40
scenarios.fault_point: between durable COMMIT and witness advance
scenarios.expected: no final protected ACK; intake/dispatch quarantined on uncertain anchor; reconcile before U replay
scenarios.evidence_required: commit gen, witness response, ACK trace, restore log

scenarios.title: Stale outbox worker
scenarios.precondition: W1 lease=5; W2 takes lease=6 after expiry
scenarios.input: W1 resumes after W2 send+ACK
scenarios.fault_point: dispatch fence just before send plus in-flight race
scenarios.expected: W1 denied if not sent; already in-flight can only rely on receiver idempotency or UNCERTAIN
scenarios.evidence_required: lease versions, receiver IDs, attempt states

scenarios.title: Common-mode alert failure
scenarios.precondition: primary DB and status reporter mistakenly share disk/credential
scenarios.input: simultaneous ENOSPC and channel auth loss
scenarios.expected: mark monitoring UNKNOWN/NO_GO; no claim of independent alert continuity; activate out-of-band runbook
scenarios.evidence_required: fault-domain map, out-of-band operator receipt
